ost.outcome: The one user of these dotfiles finds no worktree of a merged or closed pull request left in ~/.herdr/worktrees or in the list of workspaces of herdr, so that the worktrees don't pile up.

opportunities.opportunity: The worktree that `herdr worktree create` made for a pull request is removed once the pull request is merged or closed, so that worktrees don't pile up in ~/.herdr/worktrees and in the list of workspaces of herdr.
